title: Enclosure of uses
previewText: In Manufacturing Districts, the underlying regulations of Section 42-50 (SUPPLEMENTARY USE REGULATIONS) shall apply, except that all storage of materials or products shall be located within completely enclosed buildings regardless of distance from a Residence District.
